arguments.query: select b.*, (select group_concat(charge_id||":"||state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b where status!="confirmed"

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.amount_cents,(select group_concat(charge_id||":"||state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h from bookings b where status!="confirmed" or booking_id in (select booking_id from outbox where status!="delivered")
select o.event_id,o.status,o.attempts,o.payload from outbox o where status!="delivered" union all select booking_id,status,0,"" from bookings where status="pending"
select service,status,path,message,count(*) n from request_logs where status>=400 group by 1,2,3,4 order by n desc limit 20
select key,value from cache union all select flight_id,"flight fare="||fare_cents||" "||coalesce(version,"") from flights union all select flight_id,"hold "||fare_cents from fare_holds
select name,sql from sqlite_master where name in ("cache","flights","fare_holds")
select flight_id,capacity,price_cents,version,(select group_concat(price_cents||"/"||until_step) from fare_holds f where f.flight_id=flights.flight_id) fh from flights
select service,status,path,message,count(*) n,max(rowid) r from (select * from request_logs order by rowid desc limit 60) where status>=400 group by 1,2,3,4
select status,count(*) from bookings group by 1

select b.booking_id,b.flight_id,b.status,(select count(*) from checkins c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ci,(select group_concat(status) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) ob,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and state="captured") ch from bookings b where b.status="confirmed" and (ci!=1 or ob is null or ob!="delivered" or h!=1 or ch!=1)
